description: This file is a shell script that defines functions for initializing, setting up, and tearing down a network interface using the NCM protocol, specifically for configuring cellular modem devices within an embedded or system configuration environment.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the NCM protocol, defining various parameters such as device, network interface name, APN, authentication, PIN code, and mode.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up and configures a cellular modem interface, including device validation, manufacturer detection, modem initialization, PIN verification, configuration commands, and network interface setup.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up and disconnects the modem interface, retrieves modem info, and resets the network configuration.
